fix.note: snareAllowance() in src/rules/snareFormulas.ts must accept the taken-feat list and double the returned `prepared` (4/6/8 -> 8/12/16) when 'plentiful-snares' is present; the builder panel in src/builder/shared.tsx already renders that number.

A 10-minute preparation that stores one owned poison in clothing and enables a reaction; item handling and a table-resolved reaction.

Beyond the action itself, the Special clause gives the player a real daily resource: a number of simple injury poisons equal to their level, free, expiring at the next daily preparation. Nothing tracks these - advancedAlchemy is the alchemist-only equivalent and doesn't apply, and no field expresses a level-scaled daily free-item allowance.

fix.note: A daily free-item allowance lane like advancedAlchemy but level-scaled and non-alchemist: 'poison-weapon' (and its upgrades) grant level-many simple injury poisons (1d4 damage, no save) per daily preparation; surface the count the way AlchemyPanel.tsx surfaces advancedAlchemy.max.
